messages.subject: stat_qq and facet_wrap
parts:
I can't get stat_qq and facet_wrap to work well together, below is an
example of my problem. Facet_grid seems to work fine.

> tmp <- data.frame(trt=rep(1:10, 40), y=rnorm(400))
> qplot(sample=y, data=tmp, stat="qq", facets=~trt)
Error: nrow * ncol >= n is not TRUE
> qplot(sample=y, data=tmp, stat="qq", facets=.~trt)

Mark Lyman, Statistician
Engineering Systems & Integration, ATK
